nodes.label: <html lang> sync (inline script + LangUpdater)
nodes.rationale: The root layout cannot see the route param, so lang is set by a blocking inline script and by LangUpdater on the client.

nodes.label: i18n Routing (es default, en)
nodes.rationale: Server pages load the dictionary and pass dict/lang as props; components never load dictionaries themselves. Both locale JSON files must keep identical keys because the Dictionary type is inferred from JSON.

nodes.label: NORABYTE Landing Page (Next.js 16 App Router)
nodes.rationale: Marketing site for a software agency in Hermosillo, Sonora; deployed on Vercel at norabyte.com; Spanish is the convention for comments, commits and copy.

nodes.label: ads.txt (IAB ads.txt 1.1 authorized sellers)
nodes.rationale: Declares the only authorized seller of norabyte.com inventory; also covers subdomains including carshing.norabyte.com.

nodes.label: Dark/Light Theming via CSS variables (--nb-*)
nodes.rationale: config/theme.ts is the intended single source of truth, injected at runtime by ThemeVarsInjector; globals.css keeps fallback values for first paint, so both must be updated together or the page flashes the old color before hydration.
